text:
priya: Following last night's partial model-load failures tied to the cloud auth vendor, we need a compact follow-up: action tracker with owners, explicit coverage windows, and recurrence detection.

yang: Agreed. PM observed auth latency spikes roughly every 48-72h. Treat as recurring transient until vendor SLA or internal mitigation.

marco: Short inventory: rollback script for bad manifests (marco), in-process token cache w/ jittered TTL (yang), cross-region failover (ops). Missing: automated circuit breaker and clearer alert classification.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4755 — summary: "intermittent auth provider latency caused partial model-load degradation". Severity: Sev3.

ops: Please include tracker columns: primary, backup, backup_contact, coverage_window_UTC, rotation_cadence, observed_interval_days. That will make rotations explicit.

priya: Defaults: infra owners weekly; oncall daily for next 2 weeks runway. Add observed_interval_days=2-3. Also add automation_status column (manual/automation-in-progress/done).

yang: Detection metric proposal: p95_auth_latency (30m moving window) and spike_count_24h. If spike_count >= 3 then page SRE and enable degraded serving mode.

marco: I'll own circuit-breaker + test plan. Proposal: when p95_auth_30m >= 1200ms for 3 samples reduce model-load concurrency to 40% and switch to cache-first reads. ETA Wed.

yang: I'll implement cache smoothing + /health/auth probe + webhook for router. When health probe fails 3x in 5m router marks provider unhealthy. ETA Thu EOD.

priya: Action items (ack please):
- Marco: circuit-breaker + test checklist (ETA Wed)
- Yang: healthcheck + cache smoothing + PR link (ETA Thu EOD)
- Ops: add tracker coverage cols + enable daily digest to #incidents for 14 days (ops-bot) (ETA today)
- Legal: capture vendor SLA language and draft SLO/credit request if recurrence persists (ETA Mon)

legal: We'll pull the current contract and flag clause gaps. If this pattern continues we'll request uptime/SLA remedies.

ops: Scheduled: ops-bot will post daily digest @09:30 to #incidents for 14 days.

marco: Quick playbook snippet (for runbook automation):
```yaml
trigger: auth_latency_spike
conditions:
  - window: 30m
    p95_auth_ms: ">=1200"
actions:
  - notify: #incidents
  - set_mode: degraded_serving
  - reduce_model_load_concurrency: 0.4
  - enable: token_cache
```

yang: Note: prefer degraded mode (smaller batches + cache reads) over full fail-open to avoid cascading retries. Adding that to KB.

priya: Please ack in-thread when you've added tracker rows / PR links. If owners need help hitting ETAs ping me directly. :thumbsup:
